content.text: Let me also check the provider activity dimension to understand how pharmacies are identified:

content.content: {"table": "ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY", "description": "One row per PSE_ACT_SNDS code, with its label.", "columns": [{"name": "PSE_ACT_SNDS", "type": "INTEGER", "description": null}, {"name": "PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": null}]}

content.text: Perfect! Now let me query to understand the date format and find pharmacies:

input.sql: SELECT DISTINCT PSE_ACT_SNDS, PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY WHERE PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB LIKE '%Pharm%' OR PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB LIKE '%pharm%'

content.text: Let me check what categories are available:

input.sql: SELECT DISTINCT PSE_ACT_SNDS, PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY ORDER BY PSE_ACT_SNDS LIMIT 20

content.text: Great! I found that pharmacies are coded as PSE_ACT_SNDS = 50. Now let me query for February 2025 reimbursements. FLX_ANN_MOI seems to be in the format YYYYMM based on the pattern:

input.sql: SELECT SUM(FLT_REM_MNT) as total_reimbursed FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.AGG_MONTHLY_SPEND_BY_CATEGORY WHERE FLX_ANN_MOI = 202502 AND PSE_ACT_SNDS = 50

content.text: Perfect! I found the answer. The total amount reimbursed at pharmacies in claims processed in February 2025 is 47,550,913.51.
